text: Cartoon explosion pop: a big full round BOOM-pop as a small capsule bursts open, a punchy deep low thump with a fluffy cloud of smoke whooshing outward and fading, comic and playful, not a real explosion, no gunshot, no debris crash, dry, no reverb, no music, no voice, no harsh high frequencies.
